title: Spending - Community Investments
summary: Understand how EPIC funding is expended toward disadvantaged and low-income communities across the project portfolio.

steps.title: Community investments overview
steps.body: The Community Investments tab is located within the Spending Insight on the Projects page. This tab helps users understand how much EPIC funding has been expended toward disadvantaged and low-income communities.

steps.title: Review funding cards
steps.body: At the top, users can see the total expended amount, the DAC / LI expended amount, and the DAC / LI share of total spending. This gives users a quick view of how much spending is supporting priority communities.

steps.title: Review DAC / LI share by EPIC period
steps.body: The next section breaks down DAC / LI spending by EPIC period. Users can compare each EPIC period to see how much spending went toward disadvantaged and low-income communities.
steps.alt: DAC / LI Share by EPIC Period

steps.title: Review spending by investment area
steps.body: The final section shows DAC / LI spending by investment area. This helps users see which investment areas have the highest DAC / LI expenditures.
